exit_status_binding.frozen_extraction_rule: no exitCode field is surfaced by Pi 0.73.0 on this path, so the derivation uses event.isError; both a known-failure and a known-success command classify correctly, which is the condition Gen47 set for accepting the fallback

extension_hashes.note: arm B's treatment is unchanged; the only edit is the observation-only payload hook that Gen47 asked to be applied identically to both arms, so its hash necessarily moves and both values are recorded here

provider_payload_observer.non_mutation_evidence: Pi's runner applies a handler result only when it is not undefined (`if (handlerResult !== undefined)` in core/extensions/runner.js), and a synthetic probe confirmed the payload object is unchanged
provider_payload_observer.why: C removes three tools, so tool schemas differ between arms and message bytes alone would understate the difference in what is actually sent

tree_digest_correction.defect: arm C computed the tree with `git add -A` against the REAL index on every tool result, which stages files the agent can see with an ordinary `git status`, and only arm C did it - a treatment difference disguised as an observation
tree_digest_correction.fix: compute the same tree in a temporary index seeded from HEAD via GIT_INDEX_FILE, then delete it
tree_digest_correction.index_measurement_caveat: the earlier run reported a changed index hash because the fingerprint itself ran git status, which refreshes the index stat cache; isolated, the digest calls leave the index byte-identical
